common.nothingToShow: Nothing to show in the {{view}} view.
explain.validRoot: Contour accepted the proxy and serves the host {{fqdn}}.
explain.validRootWarnings: Contour accepted the proxy and serves the host {{fqdn}}, with the warnings below.
explain.validIncluded: Contour accepted the proxy: a root proxy includes it, and its routes are served under that root's host.
explain.validIncludedWarnings: Contour accepted the proxy, with the warnings below: a root proxy includes it, and its routes are served under that root's host.
explain.orphaned: No root HTTPProxy includes this proxy, so Contour ignores it. Include it from a root proxy (spec.includes), or give it a virtualhost to make it a root.
explain.pending: No Contour has processed this proxy yet: Contour is not running, or the proxy belongs to another Contour.
explain.pendingClass: No Contour has processed this proxy yet: Contour is not running, or no Contour serves the ingress class {{class}}.
explain.invalid: Contour rejected the proxy ({{reason}}). The errors below say what to fix.
explain.invalidInPart: Contour serves the proxy in part ({{reason}}): the parts named below are left out, and requests to them get a 502 or 503 response.
explain.duplicateVhost: Another HTTPProxy uses the same host {{fqdn}}, so Contour serves neither of them ({{reason}}).
explain.rootNamespace: Contour does not accept root proxies in this namespace ({{reason}}): it is started with --root-namespaces, which Sextant cannot see. Move the root to one of those namespaces, or make this proxy an included one.
explain.includeCycle: The includes form a cycle ({{reason}}), so Contour serves none of this proxy's routes.
explain.delegationNotPermitted: The TLS Secret is in another namespace, and no TLSCertificateDelegation there lets this namespace use it ({{reason}}).
explain.secretNotValid: The TLS Secret is missing or holds no valid certificate ({{reason}}).
explain.noFqdn: The virtualhost names no fqdn ({{reason}}): a root proxy needs a host.
explain.nothingDefined: The proxy has no routes, includes or tcpproxy ({{reason}}).
explain.extensionInvalid: Contour does not accept this extension service ({{reason}}): proxies that use it fail their authorization or rate limit checks.
fields.delegationNotServed: The cluster does not serve TLSCertificateDelegation.
fields.delegationUnknown: The TLSCertificateDelegations of the Secret's namespace cannot be read.
fields.delegationMissing: No TLSCertificateDelegation in namespace {{namespace}} lets namespace {{target}} use this Secret.

routes.mirror: Mirror: a copy of {{percent}}% of requests
routes.noService: No service: requests get a 503 response

tree.rootIncluded: A root cannot be included: Contour answers 502
tree.failed: The HTTPProxies of the cluster cannot be read, so the delegation tree is not known.
tree.noRoot: No root HTTPProxy includes this proxy.
tree.truncated: The cluster has more HTTPProxies than Sextant reads at once: the tree may be incomplete.
delegations.explain: Lets HTTPProxies of the target namespaces use these Secrets of this namespace as their TLS certificate (written as namespace/name in spec.virtualhost.tls.secretName).
